MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual orders, as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual orders together.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which the advised trade transaction was executed.

OrderDateTime.name: Order Date Time
OrderDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the order was placed by the investor.

RequestedFutureTradeDate.name: Requested Future Trade Date
RequestedFutureTradeDate.definition: Future date at which the investor requests the order to be executed.|The specification of a requested future trade date is not allowed in some markets. The date must be a date in the future.

CancellationRight.name: Cancellation Right
CancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of an investor with respect to an investment fund order.

ExtendedCancellationRight.name: Extended Cancellation Right
ExtendedCancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of an investor with respect to an investment fund order.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Account impacted by an investment fund order.

TotalSettlementAmount.name: Total Settlement Amount
TotalSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid /to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument in the multiple order.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which cash is available.

BulkCashSettlementDetails.name: Bulk Cash Settlement Details
BulkCashSettlementDetails.definition: Payment transaction resulting from the investment fund order execution.

BulkCashSettlementDetails2Rule.definition: Either IndividualExecutionDetails/CashSettlementDetails or BulkCashSettlementDetails may be present, but not both.

SettlementCurrency4Rule.definition: If BulkCashSettlementDetails is present, then Currency in IndividualExecutionDetails/SettlementAmount must be the same in all occurrences of IndividualOrderDetails.

CashSettlementDateRule.definition: Either CashSettlementDate is present or all occurrences of IndividualExecutionDetails/CashSettlementDate are present, but not both.

OrderOriginatorEligibility3Rule.definition: Either InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility or (one or more instances of IndividualExecutionDetails/RelatedPartiesDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility) may be present, but not both.

CancellationRightOrExtendedCancellationR.definition: Either CancellationRight or ExtendedCancellationRight may be present but not both.
